chunks: How will you comprehend what Sijjin is?

key_terms.سِجِّينُ: Sijjin, the lowest grade of Hell or the book of records of the wicked

ai.seo_question: What is Sijjin in the Quran and where is it located?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Sijjin' is identified as the lowest stratum of Hell, serving as the repository for the records of the wicked, thereby deepening the rhetorical warning against the deceitful practices of the Mutaffifin. This concept underscores the divine precision in recording minor injustices, linking the physical act of short-changing in trade to eternal spiritual accountability. The verse thus serves as a profound reminder of the severity of moral corruption in commercial dealings.
